sentences.text: Mr. S. V. Suryawanshi, Advocate for Applicant

Mr. S. P. Joshi, App for Respondents-State
 ...

DATED : 11.11.2025 PER COURT :
1. Issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 27.11.2025.

The learned APP waives notice for respondents-State.
2.

In the meanwhile, looking to the nature of the allegations and the fact that the applicant is stated to be merely the owner of the two wheeler involved, I am inclined to protect the applicant until the next date of hearing.

Hence, the following order:-
 ORDER A) In the event of arrest in connection with the FIR bearing Crime No. 880 of 2025, registered with MIDC Wajuj Police Station, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar City, District - Chhatrapati Sambhajingar for the offence punishable under Sections 26(1), 26(2)(iv), 27(3)(d), 27(3)(e), 30(2)(a), 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 and under Sections 123, 223, 274, 275, 3(5) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing PR Bond of Rs. 50,000/-,
with one or two sureties in the like amount.
